title: PEM-encoded private key: one-property twin (public-prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix is that of a public sibling identifier rather than the secret. Legacy mutation notes: public material: RFC 7468 PUBLIC KEY block of the same test key vs PRIVATE KEY. Twin of "PEM-encoded private key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of private-key-ed25519-plain: public material: RFC 7468 PUBLIC KEY block of the same test key vs PRIVATE KEY. The provider documents this namespace as public, so silence is provider-evidenced.
